info.name: Packrat API
info.description:
REST API for Packrat inventory (`packrat_api`). Set `base_url` if you use another host/port (`LISTEN_ADDR`).

Successful JSON responses use `{ "data": ... }`. Error JSON uses `{ "error": { "message": "..." } }`. DELETE success is 204 with no body.

**Auth:** after `POST /api/login`, send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on all routes except `/api/health`, `/api/ready`, `/api/users`, and `/api/login`. Set collection variable `auth_token` from the login response.

**Workspaces:** `GET /api/me/tenants` lists tenants for the session user (`user_tenants`). `POST /api/tenants` creates a tenant and adds the caller as a member.

**Assets** are under `/api/tenants/{{tenant_id}}/assets/...`.

- **GET /api/health** — liveness (no DB).
- **GET /api/ready** — readiness (`SELECT 1` on Postgres).
- **POST /api/users** — register: `email` + `password`; returns `UserDto` (201).
- **POST /api/login** — email/password; returns `user_id` and opaque `token` on success.
- **GET /api/me/tenants** — list workspaces for the authenticated user.
- **GET /api/tenants/:tenant_id/assets** — list active (non-deleted) assets for that tenant.
- **POST /api/tenants/:tenant_id/assets/search** — search by `name` (exact) and/or `fuzzyname` (case-insensitive substring).
- **GET /api/tenants/:tenant_id/assets/:id/children** — active rows whose `parent_id` is that id.

request.description: Liveness probe. 200 JSON: `{ "data": { "status": "ok" } }`. Does not hit the database.
Readiness probe: runs `SELECT 1` on Postgres. 200 with `{ "data": { "status": "ready", "database": "ok" } }` when DB is up; 503 with standard error JSON if the database is unreachable.

200: `{ "data": { "user_id": number, "token": "hex..." } }`. 401 for wrong email/password (same message). 400 if email or password empty. Persists a session row. Copy `data.token` into the `auth_token` collection variable for protected requests.

Sign-up: same shape as login body. 201: `{ "data": { "id", "email", "created", "updated" } }` (UserDto). 400 for empty/invalid email. 409 if email already registered. Does not create a session; call Login after.
Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Returns `{ "data": [ TenantDto, ... ] }` for tenants linked via `user_tenants` for the session user only.
Returns `{ "data": [ AssetDto, ... ] }` for assets in this tenant where `deleted` is null, ordered by name (case-insensitive). AssetDto includes `tenant_id`.

Body JSON: optional `name` (exact match on stored name, case-sensitive) and optional `fuzzyname` (case-insensitive substring). At least one must be non-empty. Both may be set; filters are combined with AND. Returns `{ "data": [ AssetDto, ... ] }` for active assets only in this tenant.
Creates a root asset when `parent_id` is null. Set `parent_id` to an existing asset id in the same tenant to nest.
Returns 404 if the asset does not exist in this tenant. Change the `1` in the path to another id as needed.
Returns `{ "data": [ AssetDto, ... ] }` for active assets with `parent_id` equal to the path id (ordered by name). Empty array if none. Change `1` in the path as needed.
204 on success. 404 if not found. 409 if the asset still has children. Change the `1` in the path to another id as needed.
